scripts.test:server: tsx --test server/httpAuth.test.ts server/httpRoutes.test.ts server/wsHandler.test.ts server/RollbackManager.test.ts server/utils/buildCommand.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck:server && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.package:server: npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && mkdir -p build && cd dist && tar czf ../build/server.tar.gz server/ && echo "\n✅ 打包完成: build/server.tar.gz"
scripts.package:server:zip: npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && cp server/models.json dist/server/ && cp package.json dist/server/ && cd dist && cp -r ../node_modules node_modules && mkdir -p ../build && tar czf ../build/server.tar.gz server/ node_modules/ && rm -rf node_modules && echo "\n✅ 离线部署包完成: build/server.tar.gz (含 node_modules)"
scripts.package:full:zip: npm run build && npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && cp server/models.json dist/server/ && cp package.json package-lock.json dist/ && mkdir -p build && cd dist && tar czf ../build/full.tar.gz . && echo "\n✅ 全量部署包完成: build/full.tar.gz (不含 node_modules，需在目标机 npm ci)"
scripts.package:full:linux: npm run build && npm run build:server && cp -r server/prompts server/skills dist/server/ && cp server/models.json dist/server/ && cp package.json package-lock.json start-offline.sh dist/ && cd dist && rm -rf node_modules && npm install --os=linux --cpu=x64 --ignore-scripts && cd .. && mkdir -p build && cp -r dist build/dist && cp start-offline.sh build/ && cd build && tar czf full.tar.gz . && cd .. && rm -rf build/dist build/start-offline.sh dist/node_modules && echo "\n✅ Linux x64 离线部署包完成: build/full.tar.gz (含 node_modules，平台: linux-x64)"
